coverage_notes:
SOURCES USED (in order of reliability for this dataset):
1. rolltide.com official athletics staff directory, Wayback capture of Nov 16, 2015 (in-season): https://web.archive.org/web/20151116025250/http://www.rolltide.com/staffdir/alab-staffdir.html — this is the single best source. Its "Football" section lists all on-field coaches, operations/personnel staff, all eight "Football Analyst" titles and the graduate assistants, and separate sections cover Strength and Conditioning, Training (sports medicine), Equipment, Video Services and Communications. Every row is plain text of the form "Name, Title" inside one table cell, so the quotes are exactly contiguous page text.
2. Two later captures of the same directory, Dec 28, 2015 (https://web.archive.org/web/20151228222004/...) and Jan 10, 2016 — the day before the CFP title game (https://web.archive.org/web/20160110185043/...) — used to catch late-season changes (Pruitt appearing, Wilson Love appearing, Rocky Colburn dropping off).
3. Archived rolltide.com individual coach bio pages (fall 2015) for the 13 coaches, which give each coach's role and season count in running prose.
4. 2015 Alabama Football Media Guide PDF (posted July 29, 2015), archived at https://web.archive.org/web/20160313043706/http://grfx.cstv.com/photos/schools/alab/sports/m-footbl/auto_pdf/2015-16/misc_non_event/20150729MFBmedia-guide.pdf — pages 84-88 ("Coaches and Staff" / "Support Staff") carry full-page bios for Dickens, Wright, Jeff Allen, Springer, Finney, Roach, Schumann and Stevenson, plus a 35-person photo grid of support staff on guide page 88 (PDF page 93).
5. Wikipedia (2015 team page + individual bios) as corroboration for several analysts and graduate assistants.
6. CFP National Championship game notes PDF dated Jan 6, 2016 (https://web.archive.org/web/20160122101801/http://grfx.cstv.com/photos/schools/alab/sports/m-footbl/auto_pdf/2015-16/release/release_20160106aaa.pdf), which still lists Kirby Smart as defensive coordinator five days before the title game.

PDF QUOTES: for the media guide and the game-notes PDF I set quote to "" per instructions. The PDF text layer is corrupted by broken ligatures throughout ("fi eld", "fi rst", "Lane Kiffi  n"), so a mechanical string match against extracted text is unreliable. The exact rendered wording is given in each source note instead.

WHAT I COULD NOT DOCUMENT / CAVEATS:
- Jeremy Pruitt is a genuine ambiguity, not a filler row. He does NOT appear in the Nov 16, 2015 directory (Kirby Smart is listed as DC there), but he IS listed as "Jeremy Pruitt, Defensive Coordinator" in place of Smart in both the Dec 28, 2015 and Jan 10, 2016 captures — i.e. on the official staff directory the day before the championship game. Smart, however, remained and coached the Jan 11, 2016 title game (he is still the DC in the Jan 6, 2016 game notes). I included Pruitt with a midseason_note; whether he earns a ring under the "on staff at the championship game" rule is a judgment call I could not resolve from primary sources.
- Dan Lanning's departure date is not documented. Memphis announced hiring him on Dec 8, 2015, roughly five weeks before the title game. His Wikipedia bio nonetheless credits him with the 2015 season and the CFP championship. I could not find a source stating whether he worked the Cotton Bowl (Dec 31) or the title game (Jan 11).
- Jeff Dillman appears in the media guide's football Support Staff grid under "STRENGTH & CONDITIONING" but appears in NEITHER the Nov 2015 nor the Jan 2016 staff directory, so his presence during the season is unverified. Flagged in his note. He is included only because the program's own media guide lists him; treat as low confidence.
- Gary Cramer, Eddie Wilder and Jessie Peoples are documented ONLY in the media guide support-staff grid (FCA director and two state troopers). No HTML source found; quotes are empty.
- The media guide lists a person as "ERIC KEISAU"; the staff directory and all other sources spell it "Eric Kiesau" (the correct spelling). Likewise the directory misspells "Glen Schumann" (correct: Glenn Schumann) and abbreviates Aazaar Abdul-Rahim as "Aazaar A. Rahim". I used the correct names and quoted the sources verbatim.
- SCOPE BOUNDARY: rolltide.com's directory is department-wide and lists several hundred people (ticket office, business office, facilities, other sports). I included only (a) everyone in the directory's Football section, (b) football-designated staff from the Strength and Conditioning, Training, Equipment, Video Services and Communications sections, and (c) everyone pictured in the media guide's football Support Staff grid. Department-wide staff who were NOT in the football media guide and NOT football-designated were excluded — notably assistant strength coaches Rocky Colburn (present Nov 2015, gone by Jan 2016), Michelle Martin Diltz, Deanna Hayes, Jim Hamner, Mark Hocke, Jason Poeth and Lou DeNeen, athletic interns Jarwarski Beckum, Josh Hampton and Alex Watkins, athletic trainers Sherry Kimbro and Bill McDonald, and equipment assistants Jakob Walden and Garrett Walker. Any of these may reasonably belong in a "full staff" count; I left them out to avoid inflating the list with non-football personnel, but they are recoverable from the same directory URL.
- No one on the 2015 staff carried a "quality control" title; Alabama used "Football Analyst" for that tier, so the qc category is empty.
- Student assistants, undergraduate assistants and team managers are not enumerated in any source I found.
